overview: We connect your Framer site to the tools you use so leads and signups arrive without copying by hand. That can mean a form sending entries to your CRM, a signup going to your email list, a booking calendar embedded on a page, or analytics measuring the actions that matter. We set it up in your own accounts, test with real entries and write down the data flow.

faq: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, Calendly, Google Sheets, Airtable, Slack and others through Framer forms, embeds or an automation tool. Tell us your tools and we confirm.
Do I need paid plans for those tools?
Sometimes. We say so before we start. Plans are billed by each provider directly to you, and we use free tiers wherever they do the job.
We add clear consent wording and a checkbox where needed and follow each tool's rules. You remain responsible for your own legal duties, so check them with an advisor.
Does Framer let me send form data out?
Yes, through its form options, webhooks and embeds, depending on your plan. We check what your plan allows and choose the simplest working route.
